links.comparator_used: Same models without retrieval (parametric knowledge alone)
links.outcome: Correct answers on OGCaReBench (free-form off-guideline clinical questions)
links.effect: Best baseline GPT-5.2 without retrieval answered 56% correctly; augmenting with retrieved medical articles improved performance up to 82% (using GPT-5.2)
links.quote: Augmenting models with retrieved medical articles improves this performance to up to 82% (using GPT-5.2) highlighting the importance of evidence-grounding for real-world medical reasoning tasks.
